caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate wooden stand colored in shades of reddish-brown with visible wood grain texture throughout. The stand features a wide, curving back panel that is tallest in the middle and slopes downward toward the edges. Below the back panel is a slightly protruding ledge with a carved floral or leaf-like motif at its center. The main support structure consists of two lyre-shaped elements with curled ends, symmetrically flanking a central negative space. The base is broad, stepped, and has decorative beading along its upper ledge and scroll-shaped feet at each corner, giving a sturdy appearance. The object is centered within a simple rectangular border sketched in fine lines. In the bottom right corner of the page, there is an inset diagram with dimensions and a smaller, simplified outline of the stand, annotated with numerical measurements. The artist's signature and date appear in the lower left corner of the larger border. The background is an off-white or light cream color, and the image is rendered in a realistic, detailed style.
title: Wall Table
